name: Nature
reference_style_description: Numbered references in superscript, e.g. text^1,2^. References listed numerically at end.
figure_placement_description: Figures and figure legends placed at the end of the manuscript after the references.
table_placement_description: Tables placed at the end of the manuscript after figures.

declaration_descriptions.competing_interests: A statement declaring any competing financial or non-financial interests.
declaration_descriptions.data_availability: A statement describing where the data supporting the findings can be accessed.
declaration_descriptions.author_contributions: A statement describing each author's specific contribution.

notes: Methods section appears after Discussion, not before Results. Abstract is unstructured (no subheadings). Word limit applies to main text excluding abstract, methods, references, and figure legends.
